service.description: Whether a proposed change keeps a usable instance administration path: an account that, after the change, now and at each later date it names, is a date-valid member of ADMIN, not permanently disabled, not terminated, able to authenticate (a password, or an external identity with an enabled sign-in flow), holding a date-valid factor where any of its groups requires one, and admitted by the account's and its groups' ipAllowed from the acting administrator's address; counted from the database with authorization off. The answer is a reason, never an error: allowed, or ADMINISTRATION_PATH with the reason; the paths before and after are counts only. A change on an instance with no path is not refused for it. Needs ADMIN_ACCESS_VIEW or ADMIN_IDENTITY_VIEW.

parameter.name: proposed
parameter.description: memberships: a List of {userGroupId, userId, fromDate, thruDate} rows replacing the stored row of the same key or added; groups: {userGroupId: {requireAuthcFactor, ipAllowed}}; accounts: {userId: {disabled, disabledDateTime, terminateDate, ipAllowed}}; endedFactorIds: the factors a reset ends

service.description: The sessions of an account, newest first: each visit since sinceDays (30 by default) or, with activeOnly, those with a live web session; each named by its visit (sessionKey), never its cookie, token or contents, with when it started and was last seen, a client summary (browser and system, never the user agent), the address and place, its state (active, ended, expired) and whether it is the caller's current one. The caller's own (no userId), or with ADMIN_IDENTITY_VIEW another user's (userId), the users of userIdList, or every user's (allUsers).

Ends sessions at once on every server (impl-admin F4): those named by sessionKey (a visit), or with allOthers every other session of the account (userId, else the caller's). The caller's own sessions but the current one, or with ADMIN_IDENTITY_MANAGE another user's; a session of another account than userId, or another user's without the permission, or of an account in a privileged group the caller is not in or holding a sealed permission the caller lacks (bounded delegation), is refused and counted. Its next request starts over signed out and its notification socket closes at its next check. Credentials (keys, app passwords) are left: revoke#AccountAccess ends them.

An account's sign-in factors (kind, verified, dates; the count of unused single use codes) and credentials (access tokens, device and sign-in keys, app passwords, SSH keys with their fingerprints, phones: kind, id, name, dates, last use), metadata only: never a secret, hash, verifier, factor option or recovery code. Current ones, with includeEnded the ended too. The caller's own, or another user's with ADMIN_IDENTITY_VIEW.

Another user's access ended at once (impl-admin F3, F42), each kind on its own (one that fails is named in failedKinds and the others still end): sessions (every server; the account's hasLoggedOut set, so a session no row names yet signs out at its next request), loginKeys (access tokens, device and sign-in keys), appPasswords (XMPP's sign-in too), sshKeys, sipDevices (each live SIP engine drops the phone) and agents (the triggers that run as the user paused with their cron jobs, the user's open agent runs asked to cancel); kindList narrows them, or one credential by credentialKind (accessToken, deviceKey, loginKey, appPassword, sshKey, sipDevice) and credentialId. The account is not disabled (the lifecycle's, P6). Needs ADMIN_IDENTITY_MANAGE, and is refused for an account in a privileged group the caller is not in or holding a sealed permission the caller lacks; the caller scopes the target and asks for ADMIN_IDENTITY_GLOBAL where the identity is shared. The caller's own credentials are refused here (the account's self-service ends them).

What userId owns of the owner's kind, for an offboarding preview: resourceList, each {resourceId, resourceName, resourceKind, transferable, note}; names only, never contents. The caller's own, or another user's with the owner's own permission.

Move one resource (the owner's own id parameter) from fromUserId to toUserId: refused (an error) without the owner's permission or when toUserId may not own it; the result names what changed (transferred).
Pause what runs as or for userId of the owner's kind (an owner's schedules) until a new owner takes it; pausedCount says how many.
